scope: one internal timing cut before the immutable pre-round core

cut_register.same_edge_priority: when both occur, the old cut token enters round and the new scalar replaces it
cut_register.reset: asynchronous active-low reset clears valid and payload
cut_register.fault: any existing sticky fault event clears cut_valid in the same edge

preserved_contracts.numeric: bit-identical product, lane coefficient, shift, tag, round, SiLU and saturation
preserved_contracts.atomic_group_admission: unchanged two-entry result FIFO and Q+R<=2
preserved_contracts.metadata: unchanged external eight-entry tag FIFO; observed SiLU occupancy remains <=6
preserved_contracts.table_reload: new admissions stop while table_valid is held; old cut and pipeline work continues until global empty; standalone wrapper emptiness excludes runner reservation, while the runner IDLE/table gate supplies that reservation fence
preserved_contracts.fatal_recovery: sticky block until external reset and full table reload

changed_contracts.scalar_obligation_bound: v10 30 -> v11 structural safe upper bound 31; directed model and RTL measurements are reported separately

directed_model_measurements.interpretation: 31 is a structural safe upper bound, not an observed value; empty admission is in triples so its observed obligation count is a multiple of three

model_abstraction.fatal_fault: the Python model removes masked old tokens for simple external reasoning; frozen RTL subcores may retain internal bits until reset, so this model proves only external output suppression, stopped admission, and reset plus full-table-reload recovery
model_abstraction.reservation_scope: the Python global-idle predicate includes the runner reservation; the standalone postprocess wrapper has no reservation port, so the runner IDLE/table gate is required for the stronger composed-system fence

counter_mapping.o_pre_accept: scalar accepted into the elastic cut
counter_mapping.o_pre_busy: true for either cut or pre-round occupancy through cnt_pre_inflight

forbidden_shortcuts: do not gate or modify either round core
do not accept a scalar when cut_valid && !pre_round_advance
do not clear cut_valid merely because table_valid is held
do not recompute coefficient or tag from a later group after capture
do not add MAC overlap, network shrink, constraint relaxation or public ports
